entries.bump_impact: mlx-sys regenerates the callback return types; mlx-rs has no custom I/O vtable implementation to rebind
entries.rationale: custom I/O callbacks are not wrapped by mlx-rs; seek now returns status and read/write callbacks return byte counts
entries.revisit_trigger: admit custom Rust reader/writer adapters separately with short-I/O, seek failure, panic containment and lifetime evidence
